coverage_issues: thinkingmachines/inkling:free and z-ai/glm-5.2:free failed with API errors (403 and 429), resulting in inconclusive verdicts due to tool failures rather than security analysis.
learnings: For -bin packages where the PKGBUILD only extracts and installs files from a checksum-verified tarball, models should avoid wasting tokens reviewing the extracted payload files (like man pages and auto-generated shell completions) since they are not executed during makepkg.

The file selection prompt should explicitly instruct models to deprioritize documentation (man pages) and auto-generated runtime scripts (completions) when the PKGBUILD has already been verified as a simple installer.
Qwen correctly identified that the tarball contents are the payload and not auditable as text, focusing appropriately on the PKGBUILD. Other models should adopt this efficiency.
